capstones.name: Fellstrike Discipline
capstones.effect: For 90 seconds, +45% accuracy, +35% damage, +20% crit chance. Strikes never miss.
capstones.description: The warrior's fell strikes find every gap in armor.

capstones.name: Repel the Wicked
capstones.effect: AE: 1500 + (level × 12) damage to undead/evils. Knockback + stun 4 seconds.
capstones.description: The paladin repels wickedness with holy force.

mechanics.notes: RIDER on Repel the Wicked AE (1500+(levelx12) vs undead/evils, damage author). 4s stun ~1 round. Knockback via combat engine.

capstones.name: Explosion of Hatred
capstones.effect: AE: 1200 + (level × 10) damage + massive hate gain on all targets. Fear for 6 seconds.
capstones.description: Hatred explodes outward from the shadowknight.

mechanics.notes: RIDER on Explosion of Hatred AE (1200+(levelx10), damage author). AE fear 6s ~1 round. Massive hate gain is threat/utility.

capstones.name: Stunning Kick
capstones.effect: Kick attack: 800 + (level × 8) damage + stun for 8 seconds. Interrupts casting. Cannot be dodged.
capstones.description: The monk's kick stuns like a thunderbolt.

mechanics.notes: RIDER on Stunning Kick damage (800+(levelx8), damage author). 8s stun ~1 round. Interrupts casting. Cannot be dodged.

capstones.name: Assassin Discipline
capstones.effect: For 60 seconds, backstabs +60% damage, +30% crit chance, can backstab from front (50% penalty).
capstones.description: The assassin needs no shadows — only opportunity.

capstones.name: Desperation
capstones.effect: Can only be used below 30% HP. For 60 seconds, +80% damage, +40% attack speed, immune to death (min 1 HP).
capstones.description: Desperation unlocks the berserker's final fury.

capstones.name: Jolting Kicks
capstones.effect: Kick: 600 + (level × 6) damage + interrupt + 4 second stun. 50% chance to knockdown.
capstones.description: The ranger's kick jolts like lightning.

mechanics.notes: RIDER on Jolting Kicks damage (600+(levelx6), damage author). Interrupts casting; 50% chance knockdown (combat engine).

capstones.name: Chameleon Strike
capstones.effect: 1200 + (level × 10) damage + 70% hate reduction. Warder +40% damage for 30 sec.

capstones.name: Bladed Song
capstones.effect: Aura (2 min): allies' melee attacks deal +150 damage. Enemies take 80/tick bleed.

capstones.name: Turn Undead
capstones.effect: Nuke: 2500 + (level × 20) damage to undead only. Unresistable. Stuns undead 6 seconds.
capstones.description: The cleric turns undead with divine wrath.

mechanics.notes: RIDER on Turn Undead nuke (2500+(levelx20) vs undead, damage author). Undead-only stun 6s ~1 round. Unresistable.

capstones.name: Spirits of Nature
capstones.effect: Summon 3 nature spirits for 90 seconds: healer, nuker, slower. Each is potent.

mechanics.description: Summons 3 nature spirits for 90 seconds: healer, nuker, slower. Each is potent.

capstones.name: Tigir's Insects
capstones.effect: AE: -35% attack speed, -25% movement, 150/tick poison for 90 seconds.

capstones.name: Phantasmal Opponent
capstones.effect: Create a copy of target (70% power) that fights for the enchanter for 1 minute.
capstones.description: The enemy faces its phantasmal double.

mechanics.description: Creates a copy of the target at 70% power that fights for the enchanter for 1 minute.

capstones.name: Virulent Talon
capstones.effect: Pet buff (5 min): attacks apply stacking poison (100/tick, stacks 5x). +25% attack speed.
capstones.description: The elemental's talons drip virulent poison.

capstones.name: Embalmer's Carapace
capstones.effect: Lich upgrade (5 min): +25% mana regen, +20% DoT damage, -15% damage taken.

capstones.name: Claw Spells
capstones.effect: For 60 seconds, nukes cast 50% faster, cost -30% mana, +20% damage. The claw strikes fast.
capstones.description: The wizard's claws rake the enemy swiftly.
